newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB slides after Oftel comment, C&W news.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB slides after Oftel comment, C&W news.

text.p: Shares in BSkyB sustained another blow on Wednesday as regulators issued a provisional order against the company's promotion with British Telecommunications, saying the deal breached BT's license.
By 0753 GMT, shares in BSkyB were off 14p to 664-1/2p, after yesterday's 18p-loss. Meanwhile, C&W shares, adding on to yesterday's 26p-advance, jumped 11-1/2p to 478-1/2p.
Today's move from Oftel, Britain's telecoms industry watchdog, comes one day after Cable & Wireless said it would merge its UK operations with those of Nynex CableComms Group and Bell Cablemedia.
The newly-created company, in which C&W will hold a controlling stake, is expected to foster a highly competitive environment.
"C&W's merger is a negative for BSkyB, and now we find Oftel blocking another piece of business," said one market maker.
However, another noted that BSkyB shares -- up by as much as 70 percent so far this year -- were overdue for a correction. The shares set a record peak at 698p on Monday.
Shares in British Telecom slipped 3p to 351p.
